task_title: AI loot-collection efficiency: loot ledger + mid-run loot sweep + trivial pickup snap

plan_review.notes: Adversarial red-team of the loot-ledger + windowed sweep + snap + descend-deferral design. 3 alternatives enumerated and argued (strengthen tactical opportunity planner; encounter-scoped drop recovery; explicit exit-cleanup transaction). Blockers fixed: (1) descend deferral drained its 1800-frame budget during the walk to the stairs - proximity check now runs first; (2) combinedRatio mixes XP+gold units and is cross-floor cumulative - documented as a same-matrix comparison metric only. Also fixed: deterministic eid tie-break for equidistant snap targets; added regression tests for the loot ledger, deferral budget/panic/exhaustion. Accepted-with-rationale: Euclidean sweep radius (12ft narrow window measured to beat path-cost-gated alternatives at 72-run scale), unbounded pre-exit greedy tour (pre-existing behaviour, panic-gated), auto-progression importing panic helpers from bt-ai-provider (same layer, extraction deferred), Floor 2 symmetry (bounded by the same frame budget, no collapse timer to lose).

Both models re-reviewed HEAD and reported clean. gpt-5.6-terra additionally flagged the still-unfilled ledger stages, which is this record itself, not a code concern.

independent_grade.notes: The diff cleanly delivers the four stated pieces. The LootLedger is a purely additive counter incremented at both spawn sites (spawnXpGem/spawnGold) and both collection sites in itemPickupSystem, with tests covering spawn-without-collect, partial collection, and cumulative accumulation. The loot-sweep generalization adds gold as a target, introduces a bounded post-combat window plus the pre-existing pre-exit window, preserves the panic-gate and engage-range safety checks, and switches the sticky latch name (xpSweep→lootSweep) consistently. The trivial-pickup snap is gated on !panic, no threats, direct-lane 1-ft probe, safe-gap check, and deterministic eid tie-break — all exercised by targeted tests including a wall-blocked case and equidistant-eid determinism. The stair-descend deferral is charged only inside the stair marker (avoiding the wall-clock bug the retro calls out), is per-world/per-floor via a WeakMap+Map so a fresh world starts at zero and Floor 1 cannot drain Floor 2's budget, and surrenders under collapse panic; tests cover deferral, exhaustion, on-stairs-only spending, cross-floor independence, and panic surrender. No Math.random/Date.now, no cross-layer import violations (auto-progression→bt-ai-provider is same layer, and Gold/XpGem come from core), and the tuning constants carry recorded 72-run measurements per rule #12. No blockers or high-confidence major issues found.
